audit.whatIsWrong: The page is built on two abilities Zaahen does not have. It calls his R a 'lock' in five places ('R Final Retribution lock', 'land the lock early', 'spend R lock on him') and his W a repositioning reset ('W Ominous Return resets deny his answer', 'resets your position out of his counter'). It also misses the single cleanest interaction in the matchup.
audit.why: Riot's text for Zaahen R: 'rises then stabs downward, damaging enemies and healing for a portion of the damage dealt' — no crowd control whatsoever. His W: 'stabs in a direction, damaging enemies hit, then pulls them toward him' — an 850-range pull, not a reposition. That pull is what answers Alpha Strike, and because Meditate is a channel, any of Zaahen's CC — the W pull or the Q recast knock-up — cancels it outright.
audit.corrected: The R 'lock' removed from whys[4], spikes[2].text, mid, late and wants.you[2] and replaced with the W pull; the Meditate cancel written into spikes[2].text; the W's real pull behaviour into whys[2] and early.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' and it is accurate — not one number appears on the page. 'Highlander resets' is also loose: it does not reset on a timer.
audit.why: Alpha Strike is 20/19.5/19/18.5/18 — extremely long for an escape — but 'basic attacks reduce Alpha Strike's cooldown', so denying his autos keeps it down. Highlander is a flat 85s, grants immunity to slows, and only extends or refunds cooldowns on a champion kill or assist. Meditate is a flat 10s, Wuju Style a flat 14s.
audit.corrected: The 20s Alpha Strike with its auto-shortening, the 85s Highlander with its slow immunity, and Wuju Style's 14s written into mid, early, whys[4], spikes[2].text and spikes[3].text.

audit.why: The content chart already reads Skill / Zaahen / Zaahen / Zaahen / Skill / Skill / Master Yi, matching the packet levelChart exactly, and every why agrees with its row. The audited mirror made no chart edits either.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal anywhere, and the true damage is attributed to the wrong ability — the packet's own suspectNames entry flags 'His Double Strike true-damage stream'.
audit.why: Double Strike is the passive: 'Every few consecutive basic attack, Master Yi strikes twice' — no true damage in it. Wuju Style (E) is what 'grants bonus true damage on basic attacks', which is why armour is the wrong purchase. Meditate restores health and reduces damage taken, so Grievous Wounds decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: True damage reattributed to Wuju Style in whys[6] and spikes[3].text; Grievous Wounds written into 'late'.
